offering_description.value: Designs, sources and markets apparel, sleepwear, bedding and accessories for babies and young children under its own brands. Sells through its own retail stores and websites, wholesale customers and licensees. Products are made by third-party contract manufacturers.

primary_products.value: baby and children's apparel; sleepwear; playwear; bedding and accessories; layette and gifts

customer_segment.value: B2C: parents and gift-givers buying baby and children's clothing; B2B: department stores, mass-market retailers and international wholesale partners

revenue_model.value: product sales: apparel sold in own stores, online and to wholesale customers; licensing or royalties: royalties from licensees for brand-name products

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets brands, sourcing from contract manufacturers, sold to consumers and retailers; retailer: operates branded retail stores and e-commerce sites selling to consumers

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Mexico, plus international wholesale and licensing partners

specialization.value: related lines: baby, toddler and kids apparel and accessories across several brands

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated branded retail stores; online: carters.com and brand e-commerce sites; third-party retail: department stores, mass-market and specialty retailers; partners / resellers: international wholesale and licensing partners
distribution_channels.category: own locations; online; third-party retail; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: children's product safety rules (CPSC, CPSIA), flammability and labeling standards, customs and trade tariffs
